caseName: Bolton v. Borough of Schuylkill Haven
caseNameFull: BOLTON v. BOROUGH OF SCHUYLKILL HAVEN
attorneys: George G. Lindsay for appellants., Calvin J. Friedberg for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ- of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
